title: Faiyah Staking (Xphere) — commingled principal pays unfunded rewards; H-O first-mover race
closed_reasons: Reward math is exact floor-linear accrual: 13/13 recent settlements and 25/25 live views wei-exact (verify_math.json)
No over-credit, no rounding gain, no double-claim (second claim pays 0), no on-behalf claim (NotAuthorized)
No free stake: stake() requires a real transferFrom (TransferFromFailed with zero balance)
Stake after endTime reverts InvalidTimeRange; pool admin functions revert OwnableUnauthorizedAccount; factory admin functions revert NotAuthorized
Claim/unstake payouts are capped at the caller's own entitlement; claimable > balance reverts NotEnoughReward (live #9, #32 stake 2)
Fresh stake in the only material open pool (#42) pays only the advertised 5%/yr, locks principal 180 days, and is negative-EV/principal-at-risk; max 180-day gain 2.47%
No native-token reentrancy value: the only native pool with balance and no stake is #10 (5 ETH, 0 stakes, owner/governance only)
key_facts: Factory proxy 0x95c8853e6bD1DBCE2428Aa6953eb7680261F22fe -> impl 0xb4f7dea2fc421f0e0088ce1e99aa0a802c5628f3; 46 pools; XEF 0x80252c2d06bbd85699c555fc3633d5b8ee67c9ad @ $0.00452386 (DefiLlama ts 1792281184)

Commingled balance identity: balance = totalStaked + totalReward - rewardDebtTotal + directDonation; the only payout guard is NotEnoughReward (0xc9d2c178) vs the current balance, never vs totalStaked or the funded bucket

Governance (P) context: factory AccessManager 0x09f716B0d2d3AD90Ad47b04481508573b6cd847c; a state-override eth_call from the factory address shows emergencyWithdrawStakingToken can move a pool's full balance; generic admin custody over ~$4.84M XEF principal, not an unprivileged path
caveats: The pool implementation is not verified on Tamsa; behavior was reconstructed from bytecode/ABI and fork execution. NotEnoughReward selector 0xc9d2c178 observed in revert data.
The public Xphere RPC (en-bkk, rpc.x-phere.com) is a full non-archive node: pinning an old fork block fails with missing trie node; the PoC forks latest and logs the block.
XEF USD value is DefiLlama-implied; no deep CEX market. A 2x price move doubles USD amounts, not token amounts.
RWA4/EL/XXX/AAA/UU/DD/EE have no observable USD price and are excluded from the USD totals.

The 2027 at-unlock projection assumes each stake remains until stime+365d (enforced by unstakeDelay=365d, verified) and that interestTime caps at 1 year (proven on #12/#14). If a stake is somehow settled early, the pot is smaller.
The 2027 pot is an accrued liability, not a balance; the race outcome is ordering-dependent. The deterministic quantity is the shortfall = accrued_at_unlock + rewardDebtTotal - totalReward.
#9/#32/#10 balances belong to deployer EOAs; they are S for the deployed code, not third-party user losses.
The #41/#42 ownerPool EOAs cannot call emergency functions; governance upgrade power is generic and not counted in E-U/H-O.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0 (reward math wei-exact 13/13 + 25/25); the live flaw is a holder-only first-mover race worth $354.06 claimable now plus a $476,602.48 unfunded pot at the 2027 unlock (today's accrued snapshot $148,366.91; $478,768.27 one-time accrual on existing stakes), with ~$13,638 stuck by the deployed code.
